watchlist_releases.name: Newton v1.8.0rc1
watchlist_releases.body:
# Newton v1.8.0rc1

Newton v1.8.0rc1 is the first release candidate for Newton 1.8, following v1.7.0. It introduces the experimental Steel articulated rigid-body solver and adds routed tendons, richer deformable workflows, core passive joint springs, and a new Kamino dynamics backend, along with broad collision and model-building performance work. Please validate existing scenes against the migration notes below, especially XPBD stiffness tuning, Rod joints, imported joint springs, MuJoCo kinematic roots, and console output that now goes through the `newton` logger.

This release candidate's changes are still recorded as pending changelog fragments; see the [complete list of changes](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton/tree/v1.8.0rc1/changelog). A consolidated changelog will follow in a later release candidate.

## Highlights

- **Experimental: Steel articulated rigid-body solver.** `SolverSteel` combines Featherstone articulated-body dynamics with a projected Gauss-Seidel contact solve that has coupled Coulomb friction.
